theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (p : Eucl P → Prop), MeasurableSet Ω → Measurable Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ Φ '' Ω)), p x) → NullMeasurableSet (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' M) (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ ∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' M)), p (Φ w)
